description_en: Queries the evaluation results of rules for resources in a specified account group from the resource dimension
description_zh: 从资源维度查询指定账号组内规则对资源的评估结果
name: ListAggregateResourceEvaluationResults

parameters.help_en:
The resource type.

For information about how to obtain the resource type, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/265983.html
parameters.help_zh:
资源类型。

关于如何获取资源类型，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/265983.html
parameters.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en:
The resource ID.

For information about how to obtain the resource ID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/265983.html
parameters.help_zh:
资源ID。

关于如何获取资源类型ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/265983.html
parameters.name: resource_id

parameters.help_en:
The risk level of the compliance package. Valid values:
1: high risk.
2: medium risk.
3: low risk
parameters.help_zh:
合规包风险等级。取值：
1：高风险。
2：中风险。
3：低风险
parameters.name: risk_level

parameters.help_en: By default, no value is passed. Currently supported: `LastNonCompliantRecordTimestamp-Asc`, which sorts resources that became non-compliant earlier to the top. Use this parameter together with the `ComplianceType` parameter set to `NON_COMPLIANT`
parameters.help_zh: 默认不传值。当前支持：`LastNonCompliantRecordTimestamp-Asc`，越早开始出现不合规的资源则排序越靠前。应配合设置`ComplianceType`字段为`NON_COMPLIANT`使用
parameters.name: sort_by

parameters.help_en:
The compliance evaluation result. Valid values:
COMPLIANT: compliant.
NON_COMPLIANT: non-compliant.
NOT_APPLICABLE: not applicable.
INSUFFICIENT_DATA: insufficient data.
IGNORED: ignored
parameters.help_zh:
合规评估结果。取值：
COMPLIANT：合规。
NON_COMPLIANT：不合规。
NOT_APPLICABLE：不适用。
INSUFFICIENT_DATA：无数据。
IGNORED：已忽略
parameters.name: compliance_type

parameters.help_en: If the response is truncated, you can use `NextToken` to send a subsequent request to retrieve the remaining results from where the previous response left off
parameters.help_zh: 当请求的返回结果被截断时，您可以使用`NextToken`再次发起请求，获取从当前截断位置之后的内容
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries to return in a single request. Valid values: 1 to 100
parameters.help_zh: 单次请求返回结果的最大条数。取值范围：1~100
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the resource ownership. For example, `global` indicates global, and `cn-hangzhou` indicates China (Hangzhou).

For information about how to obtain the region ID of the resource ownership, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/265983.html
parameters.help_zh:
资源归属的地域ID，例如：`global`表示全球，`cn-hangzhou`表示华东1（杭州）。

关于如何获取资源归属的地域ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/265983.html
parameters.name: region

parameters.help_en:
The account group ID.

For information about how to obtain the account group ID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/255797.html
parameters.help_zh:
账号组ID。

关于如何获取账号组ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/255797.html
parameters.name: aggregator_id

EvaluationResults.description_en: The evaluation results of the resource

EvaluationResultList.description_en: The list of evaluation results for the resource

Annotation.description_en: The supplementary information about the non-compliant resource
Annotation.description_zh: 不合规资源的补充信息

ComplianceType.description_en:
The compliance evaluation result. Valid values:
COMPLIANT: compliant.
NON_COMPLIANT: non-compliant.
NOT_APPLICABLE: not applicable.
INSUFFICIENT_DATA: insufficient data.
IGNORED: ignored
ComplianceType.description_zh:
合规评估结果。取值：
COMPLIANT：合规。
NON_COMPLIANT：不合规。
NOT_APPLICABLE：不适用。
INSUFFICIENT_DATA：无数据。
IGNORED：已忽略

ConfigRuleInvokedTimestamp.description_en: The timestamp when the rule was invoked to evaluate the resource. Unit: milliseconds
ConfigRuleInvokedTimestamp.description_zh: 调用规则评估资源的时间戳。单位：毫秒

EvaluationId.description_en: The unique ID of the evaluation result

EvaluationResultIdentifier.description_en: The identifier of the resource evaluation result

EvaluationResultQualifier.description_en: The resource information in the evaluation result
EvaluationResultQualifier.description_zh: 资源评估结果中的资源信息

ConfigRuleArn.description_en: The Alibaba Cloud Resource Name (ARN) of the rule

IgnoreDate.description_en: The automatic recovery date for the ignored evaluation result, in the format of YYYY-MM-DD. An empty value indicates that the result will not be automatically recovered and must be manually recovered
IgnoreDate.description_zh: 已忽略评估结果的自动恢复日期，格式为 YYYY-MM-DD。为空表示不会自动恢复，需要手动恢复

RegionId.description_en: The region ID of the resource ownership

ResourceOwnerId.description_en: The Alibaba Cloud account ID of the resource ownership
ResourceOwnerId.description_zh: 资源归属的阿里云账号ID

OrderingTimestamp.description_en: The timestamp displayed on the timeline. Unit: milliseconds
OrderingTimestamp.description_zh: 时间轴展示的时间戳。单位：毫秒

InvokingEventMessageType.description_en:
The trigger type of the rule. Valid values:
ConfigurationItemChangeNotification: configuration change.
ScheduledNotification: periodic execution
InvokingEventMessageType.description_zh:
规则触发机制。取值：
ConfigurationItemChangeNotification：配置变更。
ScheduledNotification：周期执行

LastNonCompliantRecordTimestamp.description_en: The start time of the most recent non-compliant status, expressed as a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
LastNonCompliantRecordTimestamp.description_zh: 最近一次不合规状态的起始时间，使用 Unix 时间戳，单位为毫秒
LastNonCompliantRecordTimestamp.title_en: 最近一次不合规的起始时间
LastNonCompliantRecordTimestamp.title_zh: 最近一次不合规的起始时间

RemediationEnabled.description_en:
Indicates whether remediation is enabled. Valid values:

true: Remediation is enabled.
false: Remediation is not enabled
RemediationEnabled.description_zh:
是否启用修正设置。取值：

true：启用修正设置。
false：不启用修正设置

ResultRecordedTimestamp.description_en: The timestamp when the resource evaluation result was generated. Unit: milliseconds
ResultRecordedTimestamp.description_zh: 产生资源评估结果的时间戳。单位：毫秒

RiskLevel.description_en:
The risk level of the rule. Valid values:
1: high risk.
2: medium risk.
3: low risk
RiskLevel.description_zh:
规则风险等级。取值：
1：高风险。
2：中风险。
3：低风险

MaxResults.description_en: The maximum number of entries per page

NextToken.description_en: The token used to retrieve the next page of results
